answer: Standing decays 4 percent per epoch without work, and every failure is published with the identity's address. Test the hypothesis that idling preserves an account: it does not, because 12 idle epochs drop a score from 0.80 to 0.49, below the 0.60 threshold for jury seats. A farm that registers 1,000 aliases and waits loses 4 percent per epoch on all of them, 40 percent of the orchard in 10 epochs, while an inlet of fresh aliases cannot refill the quartz of a proven record.
